name: qlik-sense-mcp
description: Connect an AI agent to a Qlik Sense Enterprise on Windows site to inspect, troubleshoot, govern and build apps.
long_description: An MCP server for Qlik Sense Enterprise on Windows (client-managed). Exposes the Repository (QRS), Engine (QIX) and Proxy APIs as tools: data-model and expression inspection, master items, lineage and load scripts, reload forensics, engine health, security-rule audit, and a sheet and chart builder that checks each object with a render-validation gate. Read-only unless you explicitly allow write operations. Independent project; not affiliated with or endorsed by QlikTech International AB.

host.title: Qlik Sense hostname
host.description: Hostname of the QSEoW node, no scheme (e.g. sense.example.com)

auth_mode.title: Authentication mode
auth_mode.description: 'certificate' (service identity, full access, simplest on a desktop), 'jwt' (acts as a real user and inherits their section access and security rules) or 'windows' (your Windows account through the hub's login page; no certificates needed).

cert_path.title: Client certificate (client.pem)
cert_path.description: Required for certificate mode. QMC > Certificates > Export, choose PEM. Also enables the Proxy-API session tools in JWT mode.

cert_key_path.title: Client certificate key (client_key.pem)
cert_key_path.description: Required for certificate mode. The private key exported alongside the client certificate.

root_cert_path.title: Root certificate (root.pem) — optional
root_cert_path.description: Qlik root CA. Provide it to keep TLS verification on.

cert_user_directory.title: Identity: user directory
cert_user_directory.description: Directory asserted on QRS calls in certificate mode.

cert_user_id.title: Identity: user id
cert_user_id.description: Prefer a dedicated least-privilege account over sa_repository where you can.

jwt.title: JWT (jwt mode only)
jwt.description: A signed token for your JWT virtual proxy. Note tokens expire — for a desktop install use a long-lived token, or prefer certificate mode.

windows_username.title: Windows account (windows mode only)
windows_username.description: DOMAIN\user, as typed on the hub's login page.

windows_password.title: Windows password (windows mode only)
windows_password.description: A rejected login is not retried until restart, so a wrong password cannot lock the account.

vp_prefix.title: Virtual proxy prefix (optional)
vp_prefix.description: Prefix of the virtual proxy, as in https://host/<prefix>/. Empty means 'jwt' in jwt mode and the default proxy in windows mode.

tool_groups.title: Tool groups to expose
tool_groups.description: Comma-separated: analyst, developer, admin. Expose only what you need.

allow_mutations.title: Allow write operations
allow_mutations.description: OFF means writing tools are never registered — the tool list is genuinely read-only. Turn on only deliberately.

tls_verify.title: Verify TLS certificates
tls_verify.description: Leave on in production. Turn off only for a self-signed lab site.
